info.title: Kion API
info.description:
This Swagger specification demonstrates how to interact with the Kion API. You may use this API to automate your interactions with the Kion software.

Swagger 2.0 Spec - generated by [go-swagger](https://github.com/go-swagger/go-swagger)

get.summary: Returns a list of accounts from the application.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specifies a name pattern to look up.

parameters.name: alias
parameters.description: Filters results to only return Accounts that match the given account alias exactly.

parameters.name: account_type
parameters.description: Filters results to only return Accounts that match the given account type ID.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Accounts with the given `key:value` colon separated label pair.
  • Multiple labels can be OR'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs separated by commas to a single label parameter (for example, label=env:production,env:staging).
  • Multiple labels can be AND'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs to different label parameters (for example, label=env:production&label=owner:jdoe).
Example\: env:production

parameters.name: label_key
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Accounts with the given label key.
  • Multiple label keys can be OR'd together by providing multiple keys separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label keys can be AND'd together by providing multiple keys to different label_key parameters (for example, label_key=env&label_key=owner).
Example\: env

parameters.name: label_value
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Accounts with the given label value.
  • Multiple label values can be OR'd together by providing multiple values separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label values can be AND'd together by providing multiple values to different label_value parameters (for example, label_value=production&label_value=jdoe).
Example\: production

parameters.name: label_id
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Accounts with the given label IDs.
  • Multiple label IDs can be OR'd together by providing multiple IDs separated by commas to a single label_id parameter (for example, label_id=3,4).
  • Multiple label IDs can be AND'd together by providing multiple IDs to different label_id parameters (for example, label_id=3&label_id=4).
Example\: 3

post.summary: Creates a URL with which you can redirect a user to Microsoft OAuth to link a Kion account to an Azure AD account.
post.description:
When account linkage completes, Kion will redirect the user back to the provided source URL with the following
query parameters -
1. "trigger" - This defines the type of callback that's occurring. This is useful if you use the same endpoint to react to multiple different callbacks.
It will be set to "linkage-result" when redirected to by this endpoint.
2. "link-success" - This will be either the string "true" or "false" and will signify whether or not the account was linked successfully.
3. "link-result-message" - This is a descriptive string which should be displayed to the user. It may express that linkage succeeded or will give more detail on why the linkage failed.

Note that the app registration registered for the tenant in which the Azure Subscription resides should have the User.Read
and Directory.Read.All MS graph delegated permissions for the account linkage to work.

requestBody.description: URL to redirect to after account linkage completes. See the account linkage callback endpoint to see the query parameters that will get added to the redirect for this source URL.

201.description: AzureLinkStartResponse returns an OAuth URL you should redirect to to perform an azure account link.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Cloud Rules with the given `key:value` colon separated label pair.
  • Multiple labels can be OR'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs separated by commas to a single label parameter (for example, label=env:production,env:staging).
  • Multiple labels can be AND'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs to different label parameters (for example, label=env:production&label=owner:jdoe).
Example\: env:production

parameters.name: label_key
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Cloud Rules with the given label key.
  • Multiple label keys can be OR'd together by providing multiple keys separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label keys can be AND'd together by providing multiple keys to different label_key parameters (for example, label_key=env&label_key=owner).
Example\: env

parameters.name: label_value
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Cloud Rules with the given label value.
  • Multiple label values can be OR'd together by providing multiple values separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label values can be AND'd together by providing multiple values to different label_value parameters (for example, label_value=production&label_value=jdoe).
Example\: production

parameters.name: label_id
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Cloud Rules with the given label IDs.
  • Multiple label IDs can be OR'd together by providing multiple IDs separated by commas to a single label_id parameter (for example, label_id=3,4).
  • Multiple label IDs can be AND'd together by providing multiple IDs to different label_id parameters (for example, label_id=3&label_id=4).
Example\: 3

parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Funding Sources with the given `key:value` colon separated label pair.
  • Multiple labels can be OR'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs separated by commas to a single label parameter (for example, label=env:production,env:staging).
  • Multiple labels can be AND'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs to different label parameters (for example, label=env:production&label=owner:jdoe).
Example\: env:production

parameters.name: label_key
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Funding Sources with the given label key.
  • Multiple label keys can be OR'd together by providing multiple keys separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label keys can be AND'd together by providing multiple keys to different label_key parameters (for example, label_key=env&label_key=owner).
Example\: env

parameters.name: label_value
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Funding Sources with the given label value.
  • Multiple label values can be OR'd together by providing multiple values separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label values can be AND'd together by providing multiple values to different label_value parameters (for example, label_value=production&label_value=jdoe).
Example\: production

parameters.name: label_id
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Funding Sources with the given label IDs.
  • Multiple label IDs can be OR'd together by providing multiple IDs separated by commas to a single label_id parameter (for example, label_id=3,4).
  • Multiple label IDs can be AND'd together by providing multiple IDs to different label_id parameters (for example, label_id=3&label_id=4).

get.summary: Returns a list of OUs from the application.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specifies a name pattern to look up.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return OUs with the given `key:value` colon separated label pair.
  • Multiple labels can be OR'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs separated by commas to a single label parameter (for example, label=env:production,env:staging).
  • Multiple labels can be AND'd together by providing multiple key:value pairs to different label parameters (for example, label=env:production&label=owner:jdoe).
Example\: env:production

parameters.name: label_key
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return OUs with the given label key.
  • Multiple label keys can be OR'd together by providing multiple keys separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label keys can be AND'd together by providing multiple keys to different label_key parameters (for example, label_key=env&label_key=owner).
Example\: env

parameters.name: label_value
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return OUs with the given label value.
  • Multiple label values can be OR'd together by providing multiple values separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label values can be AND'd together by providing multiple values to different label_value parameters (for example, label_value=production&label_value=jdoe).
Example\: production

parameters.name: label_id
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return OUs with the given label IDs.
  • Multiple label IDs can be OR'd together by providing multiple IDs separated by commas to a single label_id parameter (for example, label_id=3,4).
  • Multiple label IDs can be AND'd together by providing multiple IDs to different label_id parameters (for example, label_id=3&label_id=4).
Example\: 3

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: Specifies if archived OUs are included in the list. Options are: true, false.

parameters.name: parent_ou_id
parameters.description:
Filters results to OUs that are direct descendants of a parent OU. This includes the provided OU.

Example\: 3

parameters.name: ancestor_ou_id
parameters.description:
Filters results to OUs to all descendants of an OU. This includes the provided OU.

Example\: env:production

parameters.name: label_key
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Projects with the given label key.
  • Multiple label keys can be OR'd together by providing multiple keys separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label keys can be AND'd together by providing multiple keys to different label_key parameters (for example, label_key=env&label_key=owner).
Example\: env

parameters.name: label_value
parameters.description:
Filters results to only return Projects with the given label value.
  • Multiple label values can be OR'd together by providing multiple values separated by commas to a single label_key parameter (for example, label_key=env,owner).
  • Multiple label values can be AND'd together by providing multiple values to different label_value parameters (for example, label_value=production&label_value=jdoe).
Example\: production

parameters.name: label_id
parameters.description:

  • Multiple label IDs can be OR'd together by providing multiple IDs separated by commas to a single label_id parameter (for example, label_id=3,4).

Budget entries are created between start_datecode and end_datecode (exclusive)

amount, start_datecode, end_datecode, and funding_source_ids.

funding_source_ids.description:
